_about: The engine's own settings. The simulated world never reads this file.

staffing._assumed: The manager's own estimates of how much slower someone is in their first week on an engagement, or without a skill the engagement needs. Weak matches (below minEffectiveRate) are used only when a date is at stake.

intake._about: Accept a new engagement only if no profile's average load over the next weeks would exceed this share of what it delivers at the utilization target, counting a fifth of adjacent profiles' capacity as cover.
